services.desc: Skydive Cross Keys is located 100 miles south of New York City and is one of the closest skydiving centers to NYC. It takes roughly two hours to drive to our location from the city center. Each year, we complete over 20,000 skydives, making us the busiest skydiving facility in the Northeast! We’ve earned thousands of glowing Google reviews from happy jumpers across the country. Your safety is our top priority-fun is a very close second! If you are visiting the NYC area and don’t have your own transportation, we recommend that you either rent a car, or get an Uber or a Lyft ride. services.name: Dive trip
services.desc: Skydive Cross Keys holds a special place in the world of skydiving, one with a long and rich history. It opened its doors in 1994 when a small group of sports enthusiasts gathered around Cross Keys airport in Williamstown, NJ. Over the next two decades, it has become a true epicenter of the skydiving sport in the Northeastern region, hosting records, raising world champions, and advancing new disciplines. In the skydiving world, it’s always been known for its great vibe and a fun and supportive community. blurb: Skydive Cross Keys is the largest skydiving center in the region with high safety standards and a friendly atmosphere. Guests can make parachute jumps, schedule adventures, or join training for skydiving licenses. The facility includes parking, bathrooms, vending machines, shaded waiting areas, and souvenir options.
highlights: Largest skydiving center in the region
Fully compliant with FAA & USPA regulations
hoursText: April through October: Open DAILY 9 am - 5 pm

quotes.author: Craig Pierson
quotes.text: Plenty of open parking. Well-spoken, happy staff. Relaxed preflight and instructional process that’s not rushed or overly hyped. Clean convenient bathrooms on site. A cold water fountain and vending machines. Shaded waiting areas outside and inside too. Souvenirs. Discounts for repeat jumps, including a “wanna go back up now?” option that ALMOST had me go again.

quotes.author: Nigel James
quotes.text: Words can not describe the emotions of this experience. It changed my life, and I can almost guarantee it will change yours if you let it. The team here has a great attitude, and it’s a really cool environment… I’m more than happy the Crosskeys’ Team was focused on my safety, that was their NUMBER ONE priority.

quotes.author: Damian Simmons
quotes.text: Everybody makes you feel extremely welcome. The feeling of safety and comfort that I had was 100% at no point did I ever feel like I was in danger I would 100% recommend this place if you’re looking for a skydiving experience a life-changing experience wait no longer this is a place for you.

quotes.author: Scott Gallen
quotes.text: I would like to give a special thank you to my tandem instructor who walked me thru the whole process with a smile on his face from start to finish making my experience better than I could have ever hope for. The photo & video package is well worth it.

quotes.author: Stash McHartnett
quotes.text: The staff is simply amazing. The professionals that work here take away the anxiety and make it ALL fun. From the manifest people, instructors, packers, pilots, ground crew, and everyone in between.

quotes.author: Peter Barth
quotes.text: Probably the coolest experience of my life and I can’t say enough about all interactions with employees, from registering and training to the jump itself, they handled every step brilliantly!Google
